symbols.name: popFilterDrum
symbols.summary: A simple percussion instrument based on a "popped" resonant bandpass filter. `popFilterDrum` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: freq
params.description: the resonance frequency of the instrument in Hz

params.name: q
params.description: the q of the res filter (typically, 5 is a good value)

params.name: gate
params.description: the trigger signal (0 or 1)

symbols.name: dubDub
symbols.summary: A simple synth based on a sawtooth wave filtered by a resonant lowpass. `dubDub` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: freq
params.description: frequency of the sawtooth in Hz

params.name: ctFreq
params.description: cutoff frequency of the filter

params.name: q
params.description: Q of the filter

params.name: gate
params.description: the trigger signal (0 or 1)

symbols.name: sawTrombone
symbols.summary: A simple trombone based on a lowpassed sawtooth wave. `sawTrombone` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: freq
params.description: the frequency in Hz

params.name: gain
params.description: the gain (0-1)

params.name: gate
params.description: the gate (0 or 1)

symbols.name: combString
symbols.summary: Simplest string physical model ever based on a comb filter. `combString` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: freq
params.description: the frequency of the string in Hz

params.name: res
params.description: string T60 (resonance time) in second

params.name: gate
params.description: trigger signal (0 or 1)

symbols.name: additiveDrum
symbols.summary: A simple drum using additive synthesis. `additiveDrum` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: freq
params.description: the resonance frequency of the drum in Hz

params.name: freqRatio
params.description: a list of ratio to choose the frequency of the mode in function of `freq` e.g.(1 1.2 1.5 ...). The first element should always be one (fundamental).

params.name: gain
params.description: the gain of each mode as a list (1 0.9 0.8 ...). The first element is the gain of the fundamental.

params.name: harmDec
params.description: harmonic decay ratio (0-1): configure the speed at which higher modes decay compare to lower modes.

params.name: att
params.description: attack duration in second

params.name: rel
params.description: release duration in second

params.name: gate
params.description: trigger signal (0 or 1)

symbols.name: fm
symbols.summary: An FM synthesizer with an arbitrary number of modulators connected as a sequence. `fm` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: freqs
params.description: a list of frequencies where the first one is the frequency of the carrier and the others, the frequency of the modulator(s)

params.name: indices
params.description: the indices of modulation (Nfreqs-1)

symbols.name: kick
symbols.summary: Kick drum synthesis via a pitched sine sweep.
symbols.usage: kick(pitch, click, attack, decay, drive, gate) : _

params.name: pitch
params.description: the base frequency of the kick drum in Hz

params.name: click
params.description: the speed of the pitch envelope, tuned for [0.005s, 1s]

params.name: attack
params.description: attack time in seconds, tuned for [0.005s, 0.4s]

params.name: decay
params.description: decay time in seconds, tuned for [0.005s, 4.0s]

params.name: drive
params.description: a gain multiplier going into the saturator. Tuned for [1, 10]

params.name: gate
params.description: the gate which triggers the amp envelope

io.raw: kick(pitch, click, attack, decay, drive, gate) : _

symbols.name: clap
symbols.summary: Clap synthesis via filtered white noise.

params.name: tone
params.description: bandpass filter cutoff frequency, tuned for [400Hz, 3500Hz]

params.name: attack
params.description: attack time in seconds, tuned for [0s, 0.2s]

params.name: decay
params.description: decay time in seconds, tuned for [0s, 4.0s]

params.name: gate
params.description: the gate which triggers the amp envelope

symbols.name: hat
symbols.summary: Hi hat drum synthesis via phase modulation.

params.name: pitch
params.description: base frequency in the range [317Hz, 3170Hz]

params.name: tone
params.description: bandpass filter cutoff frequency, tuned for [800Hz, 18kHz]

params.name: attack
params.description: attack time in seconds, tuned for [0.005s, 0.2s]

params.name: decay
params.description: decay time in seconds, tuned for [0.005s, 4.0s]

params.name: gate
params.description: the gate which triggers the amp envelope
